messages.subject: Re: Jake Essex for Herne Bay Ex-Servicemen's Club?
messages.body:
Hi Debs,

Thanks for letting me know, and for keeping Jake on the books.

Can I ask what didn't feel right for you? I only ask because Herne Bay is an ex-servicemen's club, and that's exactly where Jake goes down best. He's sung in loads of ex-servicemen's clubs, and the members know every song and are up on the floor by the second set.

If it was the music, the 50s to 70s classics are exactly what those nights are built on. If it was budget, let me know what your entertainment manager has in mind for a first night and I'll see what I can do.

Have a look at the videos on the site and you'll see what I mean.

Natalie
Booking agent for Jake Essex
www.jakeessex.co.uk
